page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Your profile, the people you dress, and your account.

language.title: Language
language.description: The app, its guide and everything the stylist writes follow your choice.

personal.title: Your own build and colouring
personal.description: Optional. The stylist uses these to favour colours that flatter you near the face and cuts that suit your build, on Today, in the Stylist chat and in Shop. They are sent to OpenAI only to rank your outfits, weight is never sent, and nothing here is shown to anyone else.

people.title: People you dress
people.description: Add your children, or an adult without an email, and give each of them their own wardrobe and outfits. They never sign in. For children, nothing but descriptions of their clothes is sent to the AI. Plan looks for everyone together on the Family page.

family.title: Family members with an account
family.description: Invite the other parent, or anyone with their own Aether account, into your family. A manager can add and edit the children's clothes; a viewer can only look. Each person decides whether the family sees their own wardrobe.

units.title: Units
units.description: Each one saves as soon as you pick it.
units.temperatureExample: Weather on Today, in trip plans and family looks reads as {example}.

toast.personalSavedDescription: Today's picks and the stylist use them from your next request.
